title: [DocDB][DB Clone] Clone is failing to the time before index drop if tablet splitting takes place - Index query failure
body:
Jira Link: [DB-12082](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-12082)
### Description

Version: **2.23.0.0-b558**

Cloning to the time before index drop(if the index is created and tablet splitting took place) is failing
**Steps**:

1. Create universe with below master GFLAGs
```
tablet_split_low_phase_size_threshold_bytes= 1048576
tablet_split_high_phase_size_threshold_bytes= 10485760
tablet_split_low_phase_shard_count_per_node=8
tablet_split_high_phase_shard_count_per_node=80
```
2. Create database and table and create snapshot schedule
3. Load some data(200K rows) to table
4. Create index on table(let index table's tablets also split(>=3 tablets))
5. Collect time(t1)
6. Drop index
7. Clone DB to collected time(t1)

**Observations**:
Tried it 2 times and notice 2 different errors
1. 
```
{
        "aggregate_state": "ABORTED",
        "source_namespace_id": "00004004000030008000000000000000",
        "seq_no": "2",
        "target_namespace_name": "d12",
        "restore_time": "2024-07-08 09:39:53.188780",
        "abort_message": "Runtime error (yb/util/subprocess.cc:632): Subprocess '/home/yugabyte/yb-software/yugabyte-2.23.0.0-b558-centos-x86_64/bin/../postgres/bin/ysql_dump' terminated with non-zero exit status 256: ysql_dump: NOTICE:  yb_read_time should be set with caution.\nDETAIL:  No DDL operations should be performed while it is set and it should not be set to a timestamp before a DDL operation has been performed. It doesn't have well defined semantics for normal transactions and is only to be used after consultation\nysql_dump: [archiver (db)] query failed: ERROR:  Tablet deleted: Cleanup hidden tablets\nCONTEXT:  Catalog Version Mismatch: A DDL occurred while processing this query. Try again.\nysql_dump: [archiver (db)] query was: SELECT t.tableoid, t.oid, t.relname AS indexname, inh.inhparent AS parentidx, pg_catalog.pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid) AS indexdef, i.indnkeyatts AS indnkeyatts, i.indnatts AS indnatts, i.indkey, i.indisclustered, i.indisreplident, i.indoption, t.relpages, c.contype, c.conname, c.condeferrable, c.condeferred, c.tableoid AS contableoid, c.oid AS conoid, pg_catalog.pg_get_constraintdef(c.oid, false) AS condef, (SELECT spcname FROM pg_catalog.pg_tablespace s WHERE s.oid = t.reltablespace) AS tablespace, t.reloptions AS indreloptions, (SELECT pg_catalog.array_agg(attnum ORDER BY attnum)   FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute   WHERE attrelid = i.indexrelid AND     attstattarget >= 0) AS indstatcols,(SELECT pg_catalog.array_agg(attstattarget ORDER BY attnum)   FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute   WHERE attrelid = i.indexrelid AND     attstattarget >= 0) AS indstatvals FROM pg_catalog.pg_index i JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class t ON (t.oid = i.indexrelid) JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class t2 ON (t2.oid = i.indrelid) LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_constraint c ON (i.indrelid = c.conrelid AND i.indexrelid = c.conindid AND c.contype IN ('p','u','x')) LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_inherits inh ON (inh.inhrelid = indexrelid) WHERE i.indrelid = '16384'::pg_catalog.oid AND (i.indisvalid OR t2.relkind = 'p') AND i.indisready ORDER BY indexname\n"
    }
```
